[EN] At a Guild Master's request, I bring merchants to the Skycastle who provide costumes and accessories for all guild members to use. But only for a few hours at a time, and you'll need to pay Prestige in advance for their services.

Weapon Skins (500P) and Accessories (300P) merchants will stay for 12 hours; Costume merchants (800P) for 6.
[ES] A petición de un Guild Master, traigo al Skycastle a comerciantes que ofrecen atuendos y accesorios para que todos los miembros del gremio los usen. Pero solo por unas horas a la vez, y deberás pagar Prestige por adelantado por sus servicios.

Los comerciantes de Weapon Skins (500P) y Accessories (300P) se quedarán 12 horas; los de Costume merchants (800P), 6.
